Zero (1.0, Jun 2026) and Replicache. Zero: query-driven sync with server-authoritative mutators, needs Postgres 15+ with logical replication. Replicache: open-sourced, free, push/pull against any backend, superseded by Zero.
Postgres read-path sync ('shapes') over plain HTTP; writes go through your API. Joined Neon/Databricks Aug 2026; Electric Cloud winding down. Needs Postgres.
Electric's open protocol for ordered, replayable HTTP streams with catch-up and live tailing. Not tied to Postgres, so a Clojure server could implement it.

Reactive client store with live queries maintained by differential dataflow and optimistic writes. Query Collection works against any REST API. 1.0 RC Nov 2026. Best client-DB fit for a Clojure server.
Event-sourced client SQLite. The sync backend only has to serve an ordered event log from a cursor, which maps well onto XTDB's log. Pre-1.0, TS/Effect-heavy.
NoSQL client DB with a documented checkpoint pull/push replication protocol for any backend. A Clojure server can use XTDB system time or tx-id as the checkpoint.

Firebase-style backend with a client Datalog store. Its sync engine is Clojure: it tails the Postgres WAL and invalidates subscribed queries. 1.0 Apr 2026. Can't front XTDB, but the best open reference for a reactive-query invalidator in Clojure.
Hosted reactive backend: TypeScript server functions, query subscriptions re-run on change, own Rust database. Self-hostable under FSL. Needs its own DB.
Replicates Postgres, MongoDB, MySQL, SQL Server or Convex into client SQLite via Sync Streams; writes go through your API. XTDB is not a supported source.
Jazz 2 (alpha): a database embedded in a Node backend with mergeable and serializable transactions. TypeScript only.
Full-stack syncing database (AGPL). Acquired by Supabase; repo quiet since Jan 2026.
JSON CRDT with full history (Rust core, JS/WASM). 3.0 cut memory use 10x. For collaborative documents, not ledger entries.
Networking and storage layer for Automerge documents.
The most widely used text CRDT. v14 RC Oct 2026.
Realtime CRDT document store backed by S3. Its team joined Modal.
High-performance Rust CRDT library: rich text, lists, trees and version control.
Small reactive store with a MergeableStore CRDT and WebSocket synchronizers.
SQLite on each device, synced end-to-end encrypted through self-hostable relays.
Local-first, peer-to-peer framework for collaborative apps (FSL). Brings its own stack.
Hypermedia framework: the server streams DOM patches and signals over SSE. Any backend; official Clojure SDK in sdk/clojure. 1.0.5. The most inspectable fit for a Clojure server.
Anders Murphy's Clojure framework for Datastar: server-rendered, streamed, almost no ClojureScript.
Hypermedia attributes with SSE/WebSocket extensions. v4.
Clojure web framework pairing htmx with XTDB; XTDB v2 support in pre-release.
HTML over the wire with Turbo Streams for pushes. Rails-first, backend-agnostic.
Stateful server processes push minimal diffs over WebSocket. The reference design that Datastar, Lustre server components and Electric react to.
Gleam's Elm-architecture framework, with server components over WebSocket. Typed, immutable.
Elm: pure, immutable, no runtime exceptions, excellent compiler errors. 0.19.2 in Jul 2026 started the road to 1.0.
Sound types, immutable records, first-class React bindings. v12 Dec 2025.
TypeScript library that tracks errors and dependencies in types; pitched as reliable TypeScript for the AI era.
Reverse-engineered study of Linear's sync engine, endorsed by Linear's CTO. The clearest write-up of server authority plus client rebase.
Electric v3: one reactive program the compiler splits across client and server. Free for bootstrappers and non-commercial use, otherwise commercial.
Normalized client DB, EQL queries co-located with components, mutations and remotes.
Rapid Application Development on Fulcro: attributes drive forms, reports and resolvers.
Attribute-graph resolver engine behind Fulcro's EQL remotes.
Functional effect and streaming system Electric is built on.
Light ClojureScript dialect compiling to plain JS with JS data structures. Small bundles.
ClojureScript with the real standard library, emitting ES modules.
Paren-repair hooks for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini. In its sample log 4.2% of writes had delimiter errors and parinfer fixed all of them.
Datastar's official Clojure SDK: SSE generators for Ring and http-kit, Malli schemas, Brotli.
Combines Nexus-style data actions with Datastar.
Claude Code skill for re-frame: inspect app-db, dispatch events, trace, hot-swap handlers and time-travel in the running app.
Spec-first, AI-first successor to re-frame. Pre-alpha, not on Clojars yet.
Electric v3 starter app; where public v3 activity shows up (commits Oct 2026).
Electric demos, including an XTDB 2 alias.
Tony Kay's statecharts library, the focus of Fulcro's recent work.
Differential store sync behind Datahike's streaming writer to browser clients (beta).
New (Oct 2026) local-first sync for Clojure(Script). Unproven.
